title: linaria supina subsp. nevadensis
intro: Linaria supina subsp. nevadensis, commonly known as Nevada toadflax, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the toadflax family (Scrophulariaceae), native to the southwestern United States. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Nevada toadflax include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic, making it a potential remedy for conditions like insomnia, fever, and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of Nevada toadflax include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
